# `collate`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
collate(expr, collationName)
```

Marks a given expression with the specified collation.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Not in the function registry yet |
| Group | `string_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 4.0.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 4.0 and later |
| Arguments | 2 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
SELECT COLLATION('Spark SQL' collate UTF8_LCASE);
```

Result:

```text
SYSTEM.BUILTIN.UTF8_LCASE
```
